title: The Tale of the Ferry's Name
youtube_title: The Tale of the Ferry's Name | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: The best answer sometimes starts with hearing the whole thing.
summary: At a bedroom at lamp time, story not started yet, Auntie Luz begins to tell Eko about tale of how the ferry got its name. Eko wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
